faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
faqs.answer: Our minimum order quantity varies by product type. For standard items, MOQ is typically 1000 units. For custom designs, MOQ may be higher (usually 5000+ units) to cover tooling costs. We offer flexible pricing for bulk orders - contact us for specific MOQ requirements.

faqs.question: Do you offer custom designs and sizes?
faqs.answer: Yes! We specialize in custom solutions. Our in-house design team can create unique containers tailored to your needs - custom dimensions, colors, logos, and features. We have designed 500+ custom molds for clients. Custom orders include free design consultation and prototype samples.

faqs.question: What materials do you use? Are they food-safe?
faqs.answer: We use HDPE, PP (Polypropylene), and PET - all food-grade certified materials. All our products are BPA-free, FDA approved, and meet ISO 9001:2015 standards. We provide material certificates with every order. Our containers are suitable for food, pharmaceuticals, and industrial applications.

faqs.question: Can I get samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We offer free samples for standard products. For custom designs, we provide prototype samples after design approval (small fee may apply for custom prototypes). Samples help you verify quality, dimensions, and suitability before committing to a large order.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept multiple payment methods: bank transfers, UPI, credit/debit cards, and cash on delivery (for select orders). For large orders, we typically require 50% advance payment with balance on delivery. We also offer flexible payment terms for established clients.

faqs.question: Do you provide volume discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes! We offer competitive volume discounts. Discounts typically start at 5% for orders above 10,000 units and can go up to 25% for very large orders (100,000+ units). Pricing is transparent with no hidden costs. Contact us with your quantity requirements for a detailed quote.
